orange.purpose: The one committing key per page.

orange-wall.purpose: Side wall of the orange key.

orange-ink.purpose: Legend printed on the orange key.

amber.purpose: Live state only: readouts, lit lamps, checked detent, focus, selection.

amber-glass.purpose: Unlit segment ink on amber glass.

gunmetal-wall-dark.purpose: Wall on the charcoal mat; always darker than the mat.

chassis-highlight.purpose: Inset top light on chassis, bezel lip.

bone.purpose: Default keycap, field, kbd, bone plate; text on gunmetal.

charcoal.purpose: Cap legends, field border, state marks.

charcoal-deep.purpose: Deepest neutral; equals the dark mat.

ink.purpose: Text on the mat, light scheme.

ink-soft.purpose: Ledes, captions, labels on the mat.

ink-dark.purpose: Text on the mat, dark scheme.

ink-soft-dark.purpose: Soft text on the mat, dark scheme.

display.purpose: The one page headline on the mat. Archivo 900 at width 112%.

headline.purpose: Section headings below the deck. Archivo 850 at width 110%.

title.purpose: Row titles on the spec plate. Archivo 800 at width 108%.

body.purpose: All running text, on the mat or on gunmetal.

legend.purpose: Uppercase words printed on keys (orange key, mode keys, gunmetal keys, function keys).

readout.purpose: Uppercase tabular text on amber glass.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and knob detents in soft ink or knob ink.

shadows.name: key-wall-bone
shadows.purpose: Resting bone keycap, mode key, function key.

shadows.name: key-wall-pressed
shadows.purpose: Pressed cap or selected mode key, with translateY(4px).

shadows.name: orange-key-pressed
shadows.purpose: The committing key pressed, with translateY(7px).

shadows.name: gunmetal-key-wall
shadows.purpose: Secondary gunmetal key at rest; pressed travels 4px.

shadows.name: chassis
shadows.purpose: Deck, spec plate, function strip, readout bezel.

shadows.name: bezel-recess
shadows.purpose: Amber screen bezel set into the chassis.

shadows.name: cap-dish
shadows.purpose: Dished top of a PBT keycap, on a 7% inset rim.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; every travel, rotation and fade.

motion.name: key-travel-fast
motion.purpose: Orange key, mode keys, gunmetal keys.

motion.name: knob-turn
motion.purpose: Knob face rotation between detents (120-degree sweep).

motion.name: flip-interval
motion.purpose: Delay between consecutive keys in the sequential flip, reading order; reversed when turning back.

motion.name: auto-turn
motion.purpose: One automatic turn to the current season after the preset loads, unless the visitor touched the knob.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations collapse; the content end state is shown directly (deck opens on the season, all keys flipped, no auto-turn).

components.name: Action Key
components.description: The safety-orange committing key. Exactly one per page.
components.css: .ds-action-key { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 150px; min-height: 150px; padding: 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--orange); color: #1d0d04; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--orange-wall), 0 12px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-action-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-action-key:active { transform: translateY(7px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--orange-wall), 0 3px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-action-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action-legend { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; }

components.name: Gunmetal Key

components.html: Compare two of your sets
components.css: .ds-gunmetal-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--gunmetal); color: var(--bone); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--gunmetal-wall), 0 8px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-gunmetal-key:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--gunmetal-wall), 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-gunmetal-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Keys
components.description: Bone keys in a gunmetal tray; the selected key sits pressed with its lamp lit amber.
components.css: .ds-mode-tray { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--gunmetal); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--gunmetal-edge), 0 10px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-mode-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--bone); color: var(--charcoal); box-shadow: var(--key-wall-bone); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-mode-key::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--charcoal); } .ds-mode-key[aria-selected='true'] { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: var(--key-wall-pressed); } .ds-mode-key[aria-selected='true']::before { background: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber-dim); } .ds-mode-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Deck Field
components.description: Labelled input set into the deck like a key well; invalid state is a dashed border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 60px; padding: 0 18px; border: 3px solid var(--charcoal); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bone); color: var(--charcoal); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #6d685e; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-style: dashed; }

components.css: .ds-keycaps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 72px); gap: 12px; padding: 16px 16px 21px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--gunmetal); } .ds-keycap { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: var(--key-radius); background: var(--bone); box-shadow: var(--key-wall-bone); transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 140ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-keycap[data-tone='putty'] { background: var(--putty); box-shadow: var(--key-wall-putty); } .ds-keycap::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7%; border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); } .ds-keycap[data-pressed] { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: var(--key-wall-pressed); } .ds-keycap[data-state='unmapped']::before { border: 2px dashed var(--charcoal); opacity: 0.45; } .ds-keycap[data-state='flipped']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 7%; right: 8%; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--charcoal); } .ds-keycap-legend { position: absolute; top: 6%; left: 9%; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; color: var(--charcoal); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-bezel { padding: 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--gunmetal-edge); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 1px 0 #4a4e54; } .ds-glass { min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--amber); color: var(--amber-glass); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18), inset 0 6px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); }

components.name: Knob

components.css: .ds-knob { display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--gunmetal); } .ds-dial { width: 130px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; padding: 9px; background: var(--gunmetal-edge); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #18191c, 0 10px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-face { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(#8a8e94 0 2.5deg, #5c5f65 2.5deg 5deg); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), inset 0 -2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transition: transform 260ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-face::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 11%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%, #a9adb3 0%, #7c8086 38%, #4d5056 100%); box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35); } .ds-pointer { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 17%; left: 50%; width: 6px; height: 20%; margin-left: -3px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bone); } .ds-detents { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-detent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--bone); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.74; transition: opacity 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-detent:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-detent[aria-checked='true'] { opacity: 1; } .ds-detent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tick { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-detent[aria-checked='true'] .ds-tick { background: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber); }

narrative.overview:
The product is a piece of creator hardware sitting on a desk mat. The streamer's emotes are printed on bone and putty PBT keycaps, the season is a knurled aluminium knob that clicks through detents, a recessed amber screen reports what is live, and one safety-orange key commits. Every surface is either the mat (where the explanation and body copy live) or a gunmetal object set on it (where the controls, readouts and specification live). Nothing floats. Depth is physical: a key has a wall, travels when pressed, and casts a short layered shadow on the chassis; the chassis has its own taller wall and casts on the mat.

Density is instrument-like rather than editorial. A page shows one object at one scale, with prose beside or below it on the mat. Type is a two-voice system: Archivo at heavy weights and widened stretch for anything said to the visitor, JetBrains Mono for anything printed on the hardware (legends, labels, readouts, nav). The world is the same in both colour schemes; only the mat and its ink change, and the chassis wall darkens so the deck keeps its height on a charcoal mat.

Later Operate screens (Replace, Compare, Review) inherit this world as-is: the knob for one-of-many and continuous choices, keycaps for emotes, the amber screen for live progress and counts, and exactly one orange key for the run that changes a set.
keyCharacteristics: Gunmetal objects on a putty (light) or deep charcoal (dark) desk mat.
Bone and putty keycaps with mono legends; depth from key travel (5px) and layered shadow.
Safety orange on the one committing action per page; amber only for live state.
State that survives without hue: dashed rim, corner dot, filled versus hollow tick, pressed travel.
Archivo wide and heavy for display; JetBrains Mono for every printed legend.
No glow, no decorative gradients, no floating cards.

rules.name: The One Orange Key Rule
rules.body: A page has exactly one orange surface: the key that commits the action the page exists for. Secondary actions are gunmetal keys or bone mode keys. If a second thing wants to be orange, it is not the commit.

rules.name: The Amber Is Live Rule
rules.body: Amber means "this is the current, live state": a readout, a lit lamp, a checked detent, focus. It never carries warnings, errors or emphasis. A serious notice is a bone plate printed in ink.

rules.name: The State Without Hue Rule
rules.body: Every state must survive in greyscale. Flipped keys carry a charcoal corner dot; unmapped keys a dashed charcoal rim with the art stepped back to 35%; an invalid field a dashed border; a checked detent a filled tick against hollow ones; a selected mode key sits pressed. Hue may reinforce, never carry alone.

rules.name: The Printed Legend Rule
rules.body: Mono is for text that is physically on the hardware: a key, a screen, a dial, a field label, the nav strip. Sentences addressed to the reader are Archivo.

rules.name: The Width Is Weight Rule
rules.body: Display sizes widen as they grow heavier (108% at 800, 110% at 850, 112% at 900, 115% for the wordmark). Never set Archivo display text at default width.

rules.name: The Travel Rule
rules.body: Anything pressable has a wall, and pressing it spends the wall: translate down by the wall height minus 1px, collapse the wall to 1px. Hover never lifts; it may brighten the orange key by 4%.

rules.name: The Wall Outranks the Mat Rule
rules.body: A gunmetal object's wall is always darker than the mat it sits on, in both schemes. That is why the wall darkens to `gunmetal-wall-dark` on the charcoal mat.

dos: **Do** put every control, readout and specification on a gunmetal object with the chassis shadow, and every sentence to the reader on the mat.
**Do** give anything pressable a wall and spend it on press (translate wall height minus 1px, collapse to a 1px wall) in 120 to 140ms.
**Do** use the knob for any one-of-many or continuous choice (season, mode) and mode keys in a tray for a small set of views.
**Do** report live progress and counts on one amber screen, with tick scales for magnitude.
**Do** carry every state with a non-hue mark: corner dot, dashed rim, filled versus hollow tick, pressed travel.
**Do** show the end state directly under reduced motion.
**Do** keep orange to exactly one committing key per page.
donts: **Don't** use amber for warnings, errors or emphasis; serious notices are bone plates in ink.
**Don't** put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. Legends printed on the hardware itself (keycap numbers, a screen's corner legend, field labels) are part of the object and are fine.
**Don't** build icon feature cards; explain with the hardware (a function strip of keys, a spec plate).
**Don't** show numbers as hero-metric tiles; live counts go on the amber readout, and only real database counts are shown.
**Don't** add glow, blur halos or coloured shadows; depth is walls and contact shadows only.
**Don't** use gradients as surface decoration. Gradients only render a physical material: the knurl, the knob dome, screw heads.
**Don't** set Archivo display text at default width or mono text in sentences addressed to the reader.
**Don't** use 7TV's logo, colours or look-alike branding.
